title: Language rubric
description: The rubric for judging which programming language fits a system (EE-189), Naive ships at packages/naive/src/functions/it/language-rubric.json. Each criterion asks one question about the system, says why it matters, describes the levels of a 0 to 4 scale and carries a default weight that is an unvalidated prior. A gate criterion rules out a candidate scored 0 on it, and a weighted sum never buys a gate back. Worked examples record a system, the candidates scored on each criterion with the reason for each score, and the choice a person made. A score never decides: packages/naive/src/engine/language-rubric.ts ranks candidates and a person chooses. packages/naive/src/checks/check-language-rubric.ts checks what this schema cannot: weights that sum to 1, sources that are reference ids, decisions that are EE ids and examples that name only the rubric's criteria.

tie_band.description: Two candidates whose totals (0 to 1) differ by no more than this are reported as tied, not ordered.

question.description: The one question to ask about the system and a candidate language.

why.description: Why the answer can change the choice.

iso25010.description: The ISO/IEC 25010:2023 product quality characteristics the criterion serves. A criterion the standard does not cover (a licence) names none.

levels.description: What a score means on this criterion. Scores 0 and 4 must be described; packages/naive/src/checks/check-language-rubric.ts checks it.

weight.description: The default weight, an unvalidated prior. The criteria's weights sum to 1; a person may set others for a system.

gate.description: True when a score of 0 rules a candidate out, whatever its other scores.

decisions.description: EE decisions the criterion draws on.

examples.description: Worked examples: a system, its candidates scored with reasons and the person's choice.

system.description: What the system is and what it must do.

target.description: Where the system runs: browser, edge, server, device, a build in CI.

weights.description: Weights for this system that replace the rubric's defaults, by criterion id. A weight of 0 leaves the criterion out, unscored.

must.description: Must-haves for this system: the lowest score a candidate needs on a criterion, by criterion id. A candidate below it is ruled out.

language.description: The language, with the runtime or library that shapes it (TypeScript on Effect).

why.description: The reason for each score, citing a decision, a reference or a file.

chosen.description: The candidate a person chose. It may differ from the top score.

decided_by.description: The EE decisions that record the choice.

rated.description: Who gave the scores, when and from what. The choice is the decisions'; the scores are a rater's judgment.
